registrationStatus: Working-tree scope recorded before implementation; not a committed financial preregistration.
purpose: Compose the exact ope-rational-v2 estimator with the recorded transitions and behavior probabilities of the frozen-free successor learners causal-value-v6 and causal-ppo-v7, and bound the gap between a recorded behavior probability and the probability with which the learner actually draws that action.
addresses: The evaluation-composition and sampling-law parts of obligation 10's next action. Frozen sequential_evaluation, its refuted and counterexample-bearing paths, ope-rational-v2, ess-rational-v2 and both learners stay unchanged; CE-RL-010/011/012/014/018/019 are not retired.
data: Deterministic synthetic completed bars, exact funding events and synthetic dyadic target models only.
algorithm: Each run contributes its first H recorded transitions (H <= 32) as one episode: exact rewards converted under the learners' own rule and guarded at 2^99, recorded behavior probabilities floored at 2^-10, caller-supplied target probabilities and value models. ope-rational-v2 then computes ordinary, per-decision, weighted and doubly robust estimates and the effective sample size in exact rationals. A run shorter than H rejects the whole evaluation; nothing is dropped or padded. The estimator's 8192-bit rational size limit bounds what can be evaluated: six fixture runs at H = 32 reject, four are admitted.
budget: Fixed synthetic conformance, repeatability, exact estimator and sampling-law oracles, on-policy control, prefix-rewrite, terminal and rejection fixtures; no historical fit, holdout access, hyperparameter search, policy selection or statistical acceptance.
acceptance: Scoped source, arithmetic-gap, publication-flow and conformance evidence for the composition only. No unbiasedness, coverage, independence, variance, policy-improvement, data-support, profitability, deployment or order authority claim; the published estimate is marked unreliable and no original38 status change is implied by registration.
